<thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant M and M+2 peak of nearly equal intensity, indicating a single bromine atom. The monoisotopic mass (~199 Da) corresponds to the formula C₈H₉BrO, which matches the SMILES c1ccccc1C(Br)CO (2‑bromo‑1‑phenylethanol). The SMILES is valid and its formula aligns with the observed data, so this is the most plausible structure.</thought>
<final_answer>c1ccccc1C(Br)CO</final_answer>
